_comment: Project + region come from the Pod's GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT / GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION env vars (set by patch-deployment.yaml in your overlay). When model.vertex is omitted here, core-agent's Gemini provider falls back to those env vars at runtime — one source of truth, no sync risk between config.json and the Deployment manifest.

agent.description: Platform agent for managing GKE clusters
agent._auto_continue_comment: Finish restart-interrupted turns automatically after a pod roll (v2.8, #539/#558). One attempt per interruption, crash-loop guarded via agent_boot_log, 1h freshness window. Pair with agent.max_turn_cost_usd if unattended spend is a concern. NOTE: requires an image built after #558 — the deployment's pinned digest must be bumped past the next dev tag for this to take effect; older binaries ignore the key silently.
